title: AWKUM Announces University Closure on 9 November 2026 on Account of Allama Iqbal Day
labels: Notifications From Office of The Registrar
text:
OFFICIAL UNIVERSITY NOTIFICATION

University Closure Announcement

In Commemoration of Allama Muhammad Iqbal

Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan

09

NOVEMBER 2026 | MONDAY

Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan
has announced
that the University will remain closed on Monday, 09 November 2026,
on account of
Allama Iqbal Day
, in accordance with
the Government of Pakistan's notification.

Official Announcement

In pursuance of the press release issued by the Government of
Pakistan, Cabinet Secretariat, Cabinet Division, vide

No. 10-01/2026-Min-II dated 05 November 2026
,
Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan has notified that the
University shall remain closed on
09 November 2026

on account of Allama Iqbal Day.

Public Holiday

All University offices and academic activities shall remain
closed on Monday, 09 November 2026, in observance of
Allama Iqbal Day.

Instructions for Security Staff

The University notification further directs all security staff
to remain alert and vigilant at their respective points during
the closure.

Remembering Allama Muhammad Iqbal

Allama Muhammad Iqbal, the renowned philosopher, poet and
thinker of the subcontinent, is remembered for his vision,
intellectual contributions and inspiring message of
self-realization, knowledge and unity.

Allama Iqbal Day is observed every year on 9 November to
honour his remarkable contributions and enduring legacy.

MESSAGE FOR STUDENTS & YOUTH

خودی کو کر بلند اتنا کہ ہر تقدیر سے پہلے

خدا بندے سے خود پوچھے بتا تیری رضا کیا ہے

علامہ محمد اقبال

ALLAMA MUHAMMAD IQBAL

Inspiring the youth to pursue knowledge, build character,
develop self-confidence and aim for excellence.

ABDUL WALI KHAN UNIVERSITY MARDAN

Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan

www.awkum.edu.pk (https://www.awkum.edu.pk)

Office of the Registrar
